rows.note: Use 人口結構 for the demographic makeup of a population, especially when describing how it changes.

example.english: The demography of this area has changed a lot in recent years.
example.traditional: 呢區嘅人口結構近年變化好大。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 ge3 jan4 hau2 git3 kau3 gan6 nin4 bin3 faa3 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use 人口統計學 for the academic study of human populations and their characteristics.

example.english: The university offers a course in demography that focuses on population changes and social factors.
example.traditional: 大學開咗一科人口統計學，專門研究人口變化同社會因素。
example.jyutping: daai6 hok6 hoi1 zo2 jat1 fo1 jan4 hau2 tung2 gai3 hok6 zyun1 mun4 jin4 gau3 jan4 hau2 bin3 faa3 tung4 se5 wui2 jan1 sou3
